mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 6 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 6.

Real Madrid has begun planning for the post-Courtois era, scouting several goalkeepers as the Belgian keeper approaches the end of his career.

Kosovo's women's national team studied their upcoming opponents in preparation for the 2027 UEFA Women's Nations League after a draw in Nyon, Switzerland.

The Association of Municipalities of Kosovo warned that municipalities will face a real-term shortfall of €12.6 million in the 2027 state budget, despite overall budget growth.

Iskra Haxhi Vasileva, the new head of the Prosecutor's Office for Organized Crime and Corruption, said prosecutors will not be intimidated by political pressure and will remain independent.

Flamingos have returned to Lake Ohrid, creating a striking pink spectacle over the waters of Pogradec as the birds settle peacefully on the lake.
